n: Machine learning bias with faces lesson plan
t: A Science Buddies lesson where students train a classifier on drawn faces to see bias.
steps: Find the lesson on Science Buddies and read the full plan.
Check which tool the lesson uses. The snippets do not say.
Gather paper and pencils for drawing faces.
Ask each student to draw at least ten happy and ten sad faces.
Watch the companion video before class.
Check whether the tool needs accounts or a webcam.
